declaration.condition: company_model completeness < 60%
declaration.action: category is treated as failing regardless of governance_profile/industry_context scores; a company record cannot be usable without a minimally identified issuer

declaration.condition: fewer than 5 audited annual periods OR fewer than 12 trailing quarterly periods ingested
declaration.action: category is capped at not-ready regardless of per-field completeness, matching the project's existing five-annual/12-quarter readiness gate described in docs/data/telecom-sector.md

declaration.condition: any statement value is present without a matching source_documents/content_hash row
declaration.action: value is rejected at validation, never published — no synthetic or derived-without-declared-formula statement values are allowed (project rule, see docs/data/known-data-regressions-cleanup.md and telecom-sector.md 'no-synthetic-source' gate)

declaration.condition: a ratio is populated but one or more of its declared formula inputs is itself unavailable/not_applicable
declaration.action: publish is rejected; the ratio must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history instead of silently computed from a substituted or estimated input (no filling gaps to make a derived number look complete)

declaration.condition: a ratio is populated but one or more of its declared formula inputs is itself unavailable/not_applicable
declaration.action: publish is rejected; the ratio must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history instead of silently computed from a substituted or estimated input (no filling gaps to make a derived number look complete)

declaration.condition: a ratio is populated but one or more of its declared formula inputs is itself unavailable/not_applicable
declaration.action: publish is rejected; the ratio must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history instead of silently computed from a substituted or estimated input (no filling gaps to make a derived number look complete)

declaration.condition: a ratio is populated but one or more of its declared formula inputs is itself unavailable/not_applicable
declaration.action: publish is rejected; the ratio must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history instead of silently computed from a substituted or estimated input (no filling gaps to make a derived number look complete)

declaration.condition: a ratio is populated but one or more of its declared formula inputs is itself unavailable/not_applicable
declaration.action: publish is rejected; the ratio must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history instead of silently computed from a substituted or estimated input (no filling gaps to make a derived number look complete)

declaration.condition: relative valuation multiples (price_to_earnings, price_to_book, ev_ebitda) are below 90% even though market_data and financial_statements are both above their own thresholds
declaration.action: category fails regardless of the consensus sub-group's score, since consensus is the one part of this category this project has already accepted as structurally hard to close for free

declaration.condition: no market_data value has been retrieved from exchange_market_data_feed in the last 5 trading days for an actively listed company
declaration.action: category is flagged failing even if historical depth is otherwise strong; stale live price data cannot be averaged away by good historical coverage

declaration.condition: a dividend_per_share or payout figure is populated with no matching corporate_actions/disclosures announcement id
declaration.action: rejected at validation; dividend facts must trace to an actual announcement, never be inferred from a price change alone

declaration.condition: company_pack.reports_multiple_segments is true (multi-segment) AND segment_revenue is missing for any disclosed segment
declaration.action: category fails outright; a multi-segment company cannot be treated as complete while silently dropping one segment's revenue line

declaration.condition: sum of disclosed ownership_percentage across all holder rows for a period exceeds 100% or, once free_float is added, is inconsistent with it
declaration.action: rejected at validation; ownership must reconcile arithmetically, matching the project's existing practice of publishing ownership only when positions reconcile to 100% (docs/data/telecom-sector.md)

declaration.condition: a corporate action fact exists with no announcement_id linking it to a disclosures record
declaration.action: rejected; every action must trace to the announcement that declared it

declaration.condition: no announcement captured for an actively listed company in the trailing 180 days
declaration.action: flagged failing regardless of historical density, since a live issuer that stops appearing in the feed is far more likely to indicate a broken connector than a genuinely silent company

declaration.condition: the sector pack activates a field_group for this company but zero fields in it are populated across the trailing 4 quarters
declaration.action: category fails outright for that company even if other activated field_groups are strong, so one entirely-empty activated KPI group cannot be averaged away by a well-covered one

declaration.condition: sector_pack activates this category for a company and its score is materially near zero while financial_statements and profitability both pass their own thresholds
declaration.action: overall readiness cannot be labeled ready; this is the contract's direct implementation of the anti-averaging principle named in the task ('a whole category cannot be near-zero even if others are strong'), and mirrors the existing project rule in docs/data/telecom-sector.md that 'the engine must not label the sector ready before the weighted score and all hard gates pass'

declaration.condition: a composite score (piotroski_f_score, altman_z_score, beneish_m_score) is populated while one of its declared component sub-scores is marked unavailable
declaration.action: rejected; a composite score can never be computed from a partial input set with the gap silently zero-filled — it must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history as a whole instead

declaration.condition: any published fact anywhere in the dataset is missing one of its own category's provenance_requirements.mandatory_fields
declaration.action: that fact is excluded from its category's completeness numerator entirely (it does not count as populated) until the missing provenance is supplied — this is the single hard gate that enforces every other category's provenance_requirements block

declaration.condition: any published fact's age exceeds its own category's freshness_policy.max_age_before_stale_days
declaration.action: the fact is flagged stale and excluded from the 'currently fresh' completeness numerator, even though it remains visible as historical data with its staleness disclosed

model_separation: Investor topic availability is not factory readiness, independent accuracy or95%coverage
missing_data_policy: null/status/reason; never substitute zero, demo values or100%readiness
